_schema.purpose: End-to-end round-trip: event -> canonicalJSON -> Ed25519 sign -> AEAD seal -> envelope JSON. Each vector pins every intermediate step so a divergence in any layer is caught by a single test.

format.vectors[].name: Human label.
format.vectors[].inputs.roomSecret: base64url-no-pad of the 32-byte room secret feeding KDF (or just supply derived keys directly via `inputs.keys`).
format.vectors[].inputs.keys: Object with `eventKey` (base64url) — if `roomSecret` is null, use this directly.
format.vectors[].inputs.clientNonce: base64url-no-pad of 16 random bytes used for EnvelopeId derivation (null for event-shaped envelopes that use the simpler `SHA-256("envelope v2" || roomId || eventId)` form).
format.vectors[].inputs.aeadNonce: base64url-no-pad of the 24-byte XChaCha20 nonce. Pinned to keep ciphertext deterministic.
format.vectors[].inputs.createdAt: Integer ms timestamp baked into both event meta and envelope AAD.
format.vectors[].expected.envelopeId: Per kind: event-kind uses simpler form; signal/snapshot use clientNonce form.
format.vectors[].expected.signature: base64url-no-pad of the Ed25519 signature over canonical event bytes.
format.vectors[].expected.aadJson: UTF-8 canonical JSON of the AAD object.
format.vectors[].expected.envelope: Full envelope JSON as it would appear in the relay's DO storage AND in `POST /v2/rooms/:roomId/envelopes` request body.

vectors.name: kind=event round-trip with simple comment body
